issues: 左上角是调试标题「ODOMETER DIGIT ROLL」，数字下方只有两条灰色骨架条，没有任何上下文
190px 灰黑数字放在浅灰平底上，没有光和材质，画面大半是空的，不像「全屏王牌指标」
滚动是平移的字条 + 硬切边，残影叠成一团糊，读不出机械滚轮的质感
锁定确认只是字色加深一下，几乎不可感
changes: look 换成 midnight（深蓝夜 · 电光蓝）：340px fw800「99.98%」占画宽 ~70%（字号 190 → 340px），四个可滚数位各装在一只深色玻璃计数槽里（内凹渐变 + 上沿反光 + 发丝线框）
滚轮改成真圆柱投影：10 面滚筒按 y = r·sinθ、scaleY = cosθ、亮度 ∝ cos²θ 排布，邻位数字在槽口上下以压扁的暗影露出一线；各位起始相位错开
曲线：0–8f 匀加速到全速，位 i 于 22+i·8f 起 Hermite 减速（初速衔接无折点）冲过 0.4 格再 8f 回落锁定（46/54/62/70f「哒哒哒哒」）；滚动期按转速纵向高斯模糊，锁定时由蓝灰转白 + 槽内一次闪亮
合计确认（72f）：整排快起慢落顿挫 1→1.025→1、数字背后蓝色泛光、% 转电光蓝、一条电光细线从中间拉开——全片唯一一次光效；小数点与 % 与滚筒同基线
文案：虚构品牌 Parallax Cloud 眉题、60px 标题「API uptime across 14 regions」逐词升起、34px 副标题；hold 段整体极缓推近 1.0→1.025
issuesEn: A debug title (ODOMETER DIGIT ROLL) sat in the top-left and the number had only two grey skeleton bars under it, with no context
190px grey-black digits on a flat light-grey stage with no light or material; most of the frame was empty, not a full-screen hero metric
Rolling was a translated strip with hard-cut edges and ghost copies that smeared together, with no feel of a mechanical drum
The lock confirmation was a slight darkening of the ink, barely perceptible
changesEn: Midnight look (deep navy + electric blue): a 340px fw800 '99.98%' spanning ~70% of the frame, each rolling digit housed in a dark glass counter slot (recessed gradient, top reflection, hairline frame)

Reels are true cylinder projections: a 10-face drum laid out with y = r·sinθ, scaleY = cosθ and brightness ∝ cos²θ, so neighbouring digits show as squashed dark slivers at the slot edges; each digit starts at a different phase

Curves: 0–8f constant acceleration to full speed; digit i starts a Hermite deceleration at 22+i·8f (velocity-matched, no kink), overshoots 0.4 cell and settles back in 8f (locks at 46/54/62/70f); vertical blur scales with spin speed, and each digit turns from blue-grey to white with a slot flash on lock

Total confirmation at 72f: the row thumps 1→1.025→1 (fast up, slow down), a blue bloom behind the number, % turns electric blue and a light rule pulls open from the centre, the shot's only light effect; the decimal point and % share the drum baseline
Copy: a fictional Parallax Cloud kicker, a 60px 'API uptime across 14 regions' rising word by word and a 34px subline; the hold drifts 1.0→1.025
